source_full_text: So they held on for some time, but at last they came to a small opening in the forest, And here they found that the road split in two. There was no sign-post to direct them, And the people in the inn had not told them which of the two roads to take. What's to be done now said Rasmus. I think we had better have stayed at the inn There's no harm done said Niels.
